body.statement: For every \(P\in\mathcal P_4^{\circ}\), \(D=D_1-D_0\) is the observed-data canonical gradient of \(\theta\) in the locally unrestricted independent-censoring model, the tangent closure generated by admissible smooth submodels has squared norm \(V_P\), and every regular estimator has asymptotic variance at least \(V_P\); the estimator in thm:uniform-endpoint-efficiency attains this bound.
body.justification: A Gaussian limit alone is insufficient; this result certifies that the singular endpoint score is the efficiency benchmark and that the feasible procedure attains it.
body.gap: Westling et al. (2024), Theorem 2, derives the survival-at-time gradient under positive censoring through the horizon, while the present gradient is the directly integrated fixed-endpoint score on a model with \(G_a(1\mid x)=0\).
body.consumer: The efficiency certificate lets applied analysts compare alternative adjusted RMST procedures on the correct endpoint information scale.
